Given that $\overset{―}{CE}$ is a segment, what is the measure of $∠COD?$

$m∠COD=$
{{field-1}}${}^{∘}$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14190698/assets/7045c84435a9ed2934569aceabf9d01e01d4278de6b89329664b654dc53b5250.png)

Two angles are supplementary if their measures add up to ${180}^{∘},$ a straight angle.

Since $\overset{―}{CE}$ is a segment, we have that $∠COD$ and $∠DOE$ are supplementary. 

$$
m∠COD+m∠DOE={180}^{∘}
$$

Therefore, the measure of $∠COD$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠COD & ={180}^{∘}-m∠DOE \\  & ={180}^{∘}-{144}^{∘} \\  & ={36}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$
